verdict.rationale: YYLO documents isolated task worktrees, protected target SHAs, and benchmark execution in private fresh repositories separate from shared task worktrees, which functions as a sandbox for agent work without touching the protected/production branch (yylo-gh-4, yylo-docs-25, yylo-docs-13/23, yylo-docs-16). However this is git/repo-level isolation rather than a broader 'production data' sandbox (e.g., staging DB, live services), and there is no independent/hands-on verification of the isolation guarantees. missing for 10: evidence of non-git production-data isolation (e.g., databases/services), independent third-party confirmation that isolation holds in practice.
